faqs.a:
(a)
Generally.
Except as specifically provided for in this article or as set forth in subsection
               (b) of this section, fees for services performed by the city shall be promulgated
               by the department head responsible for such fees, who shall submit the same, together
               with supporting documents, to the city manager for approval prior to such fees becoming
               effective. Such fees shall become effective upon notice being given pursuant to
section 2-262
. Whenever the establishment of a fee as herein provided for would involve a department
               for which there is a board or commission acting in an advisory capacity to that department,
               the city manager may submit such proposed fees to that board or commission for its
               recommendations.
(b)
Criminal justice records.
Reasonable fees for the search, retrieval, and photocopying of criminal justice records
               shall be promulgated by the chief of police, approved by the city manager, and adopted
               by the city council by resolution. Such fees shall not be subject to the publication
               requirements set forth hereinbelow.
(c)
Golf course fees.
All fees associated with the use and operation of Lake Arbor Golf Course and West
               Woods Golf Club, including but not limited to membership, green, rental, and tournament
               fees, shall be promulgated by the golf course manager, approved by the city manager,
               and shall be transmitted to the city council as an informational item. Such fees shall
               not be subject to the publication requirements set forth hereinbelow and may be adjusted
               from time-to-time.
(Code 1981, § 2-181; Ord. No. 3219, § 1, 10-23-1995; Ord. No. 3853, § 1, 1-26-2004)
State Law reference—
Public record fees, C.R.S. § 24-72-205.
